newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds prices soar on currency/Chicago.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds prices soar on currency/Chicago.

text.p: UK meals and feeds prices soared on Tuesday on the back of higher Chicago futures overnight and a drop in sterling.
Chicago futures closed sharply higher on weather concerns while sterling was hit by feelings that interest rates may not now be raised in the UK in the next few weeks.
These two factors coupled together pushed up high protein soymeal offers by as much at 7.50 stg a tonne, where sellers were willing to put out prices.
"It hardly seem worth bothering, because no one is going to be interested at these levels," said one broker.
Rapemeal sellers ex-mill Erith were two stg for new crop while material from Hull and Liverpool was around one stg higher.
Sunflower meal, pellets and corn gluten feed pellets were all one stg higher.
